title: Introduce lint SLO enforcer scheduler and minimal dependency rotator for presubmit
author: Avery Chen
description: Problem: presubmit lanes frequently exceed acceptable feedback windows (lint steps commonly > 90s on large changes) and dependency churn results in stacked noisy PRs. Goal: reduce presubmit tail latency without sacrificing coverage and introduce a low-risk automated dev-dep rotator to keep devDependencies from stalling. This PR implements a constraint-aware lint scheduler (lint-slo-enforcer) that assigns lint tasks into SLO buckets and dynamically parallelizes heavy linters while honoring runner budgets, plus a minimal dep-rotator tool that creates batched PRs updating devDeps on a weekly cadence. Key changes: 1) new scheduler: internal/ci/lint_scheduler.go + entrypoint ci/scripts/lint-slo-runner.sh that reads presubmit annotations (presubmit-weight:S, M, L) and routes files to tuned containers; 2) split lint workflow: .github/workflows/lint-slo.yml—introduces short/medium/long lanes with fastfast failover and incremental cache priming; 3) dep-rotator: tools/dep-rotator/* (Go binary) that samples package.json/yarn.lock, proposes minimal updates, runs tests in ephemeral job, and opens a curated PR with changelog; 4) lightweight toolchain refactor: ci/toolchain/bootstrap.go to make presubmit images smaller and cacheable; 5) release automation tweak: release/actions/prepare_release.sh fixes a path regression observed in recent release runs. Migration plan: feature branch staged to canary org, enabled for 25% of repos via org-level flag for 48 hours, then ramp to 100% if canary metrics meet SLOs. Rollout checklist: - [x] Unit tests for scheduler logic - [x] Integration smoke runner for dep-rotator - [x] Canary traffic gating implemented - [x] Doc updates in docs/ci/presubmit.md - [x] Linear tickets linked (ENG-2319, ENG-2401) Backwards compatibility: default presubmit behavior unchanged when presubmit-weight absent; dep-rotator only opens PRs to the dev branch with opt-out label. Observability: added metrics lint_scheduler.bucket_latency, lint_scheduler.queue_depth and dep_rotator.prs_opened. Example usage: ci/scripts/lint-slo-runner.sh --files changed_files.txt --slo M. Motivation: reduces developer wait time and triage load from dependency noise while keeping updates safe and reviewable.
